hero_desc: Your restful stopover between Bergues and Saint-Omer, close to Dunkirk and Cassel.
intro_heading: A Warm Stopover in the North
intro_text1: L’Hostellerie Saint-Louis combines the pleasure of fine dining with the joy of a peaceful night’s sleep. A warm welcome and discreet, attentive service will instantly make you feel at home.
intro_text2: The quality and comfort of our 26 rooms and one apartment, all with private bathroom, WC, telephone and TV, will delight you whether you are here to unwind or on business.
badge1_text:
Hotel open 7 days a week
Reception open from 6:30 am to 10:30 pm (Mon–Sun)
badge2_text:
Open every day
(except Sunday evening & Monday lunchtime)
badge3_text:
Arnèke & Esquelbecq stations
Wheelchair accessible • Cycling and low-impact transport encouraged
std_desc:
Our Standard rooms measure approximately 19 m² and are fitted with a double bed or, in some cases, two single beds.
Note: Spa access is not included in the Standard room but can be added during your stay for an extra charge.
sup_desc:
With a surface area of 25 to 30 m², our Superior rooms feature a large bed (180 × 200 cm) or, depending on your needs, two separate beds.
✨ Included: Superior rooms include 2 hours of spa access per day for each guest.
conf_subtitle: Grand Prestige & Spa Included (32 to 43 m²)
conf_desc:
Our Comfort rooms are the largest in the hotel, measuring between 32 and 43 m². They are fitted with a large double bed and a third single bed, and some can be arranged with two separate beds.
✨ Included: Comfort rooms include 2 hours of spa access per day.
apt_desc: Spacious and perfectly laid out, our apartment comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests. Ideal for long stays with family or friends, it offers a warm setting that combines space with independence.
breakfast_text1: Discover our continental buffet to start the day well. We welcome you from 7:00 am to 9:30 am on weekdays and until 10:00 am at weekends, with a selection of fresh local produce: yoghurts, pastries, cold meats, cheeses, hot drinks and a few surprises from the house.
breakfast_note1: 🥐 Room service: Breakfast can be served in your room (+€5 per person per day).
breakfast_note2: 🌅 Leaving at dawn? We do our best to fit your schedule by preparing a takeaway breakfast box.
breakfast_price: Buffet price: €16.00 per person per day
tarifs_desc: Prices vary according to the season and room availability.
card1_text: Approx. 19 m², double bed or twin beds. Spa available for an extra charge.
card2_text: 25 to 30 m², large bed (180 × 200 cm), walk-in shower & 2-hour spa access included.
card3_text: 32 to 43 m², double bed + 3rd single bed, sitting area & 2-hour spa access included.
card4_text: Large fully equipped apartment, quiet views, pool & courtyard.
dp_text1:
Half board is available from €52 incl. VAT / person / night.
The package includes: the set menu of the day (starter + main course + dessert, drinks not included) and access to the morning breakfast buffet.
dp_text2: * For stays of less than 2 nights, or if you do not wish to take half board for your entire stay, you can add to or change the à la carte options (additional charges apply).
se_desc: The hotel has a long tradition of warmly welcoming sales representatives, technicians and professionals on the road. Located very close to the area’s main industrial and commercial hubs (Dunkirk, Saint-Omer, Bergues, Hazebrouck), we offer an all-inclusive package from Monday to Friday evening:
se_point2: Dinner of the day: starter + main course + dessert (changing daily)
se_point3: Continental breakfast buffet when you wake up
pets_text: We accept pets subject to the availability of suitable rooms. Please contact us before making any booking with a pet.
pets_details:
🐾 Rate: €20 / night per pet.
⚠️ Please note: Pets are not allowed in the restaurant.
